skills.name: Process Manager
skills.description: Start and manage long-running background processes (servers, watchers, etc.) across multiple tool calls. Use this when shell_execute would block forever.

toolDefinition.name: process_manager
toolDefinition.description:
Manage long-running background processes across tool calls.
- start: spawn a process, returns id
- poll / log: read buffered stdout+stderr output (non-blocking)
- write: send text to stdin
- kill: terminate a process
- list: list all managed processes

NOTE: Uses pipe stdio (no PTY). Interactive programs (vim, sudo with password, etc.) will not work.

id.description: [poll, log, write, kill] The process id returned by start.

text.description: [write] Text to write to the process stdin.

bytes.description: [poll, log] Maximum tail bytes to return from output buffer. Default: 4000.

start_timeout_ms.description: [start] Milliseconds to wait for early crash detection before returning process id. Default: 2000.

headers.description: Optional request headers as key-value pairs.
